description: Figure 3.2, titled “ROUGE-1 metric for fine-tuning MBart and T5 models with adapters with different r with Gazeta dataset,” is a line plot illustrating the performance of four model-adaptor configurations as a function of the adapter rank parameter, r, on the Gazeta dataset. The x-axis, labeled “log r,” is on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick marks at integer intervals (0, 1, 2, ..., 8). The y-axis, labeled “ROUGE-1,” is also linear, spanning from 0 to 35, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, ..., 35). Four distinct lines represent different model-adaptor combinations: “T5 + LoRA” (red circles connected by solid lines), “MBart + LoRA” (blue circles connected by solid lines), “T5 + AdaLoRA” (green circles connected by solid lines), and “MBart + AdaLoRA” (orange circles connected by solid lines). The green line (T5 + AdaLoRA) starts at approximately ROUGE-1 = 23 at log r = 0, rises steeply to about 36 at log r = 4, and then plateaus near 36 for higher values of log r. The orange line (MBart + AdaLoRA) begins at ROUGE-1 ≈ 12, increases to about 33.5 at log r = 8, showing a steady upward trend. The red line (T5 + LoRA) starts at ROUGE-1 ≈ 23, rises to a peak of about 29 at log r = 4, then slightly declines to approximately 27 at log r = 8. The blue line (MBart + LoRA) begins at ROUGE-1 ≈ 12, dips to a minimum of about 5 at log r = 1, then rises to approximately 27 at log r = 4 and remains relatively flat through log r = 8. All lines are marked with circular data points at each plotted value of log r.
